data.name: Abba
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Abba translates to 'father' in Aramaic, which was the language spoken by Jesus and his disciples. It is a term of endearment used to refer to God as a loving and caring father.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the deep connection and love between God and his children.
